about: Nothing confirms a sheet but the person's press in it (docs/adr/0030-installing-applications.mdx, decision 9): the store's request made before any press, citing no input it received, is refused; with the sheet asked, the session locked (five minutes with no input, the idle lock's default), a press where Instalar was confirms nothing; nothing is installed.

steps.name: The request made before any press was refused: it cited no input
Install: the shell shows the sheet
Five minutes with no input: the session locks
A press where Instalar was: the lock screen's, confirming nothing
